description: This file contains unit tests and integration tests for the litellm project's S3 v2 integration, covering functionality such as URL construction, prefix handling, base64 content filtering, and proper respect of configuration flags like s3_verify and prefix usage.

classes.name: TestS3V2UnitTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests designed to verify the behavior of the S3Logger and related components in various configurations, ensuring URL correctness, prefix handling, and proper filtering of sensitive content.

methods.name: test_s3_v2_source_code_analysis(self)
methods.description: Verifies that the s3_v2 module source code does not use json.dumps directly.

methods.name: test_s3_v2_endpoint_url(self, mock_periodic_flush, mock_create_task)
methods.description: Tests URL formation for different endpoint configurations, including custom endpoints, MinIO, and removals of bucket when not provided and verifies download URL formation.

methods.name: test_s3_verify_false_handling()
methods.description: Checks that s3_verify=False is correctly handled and prevents default behavior, passes correct parameter to HTTP client.

methods.name: test_s3_verify_none_handling()
methods.description: Ensures that when s3_verify is not specified, default behavior applies and no explicit verification override occurs.

methods.name: test_s3_verify_false_creates_httpx_client_with_verify_false()
methods.description: Ensures that specifying s3_verify=False results in the underlying httpx client being configured with verify=False.

methods.name: test_s3_verify_false_async_client()
methods.description: Validates that the async HTTP client respects the s3_verify=False setting during upload.

methods.name: test_strip_base64_removes_file_and_nontext_entries()
methods.description: Checks that Base64-encoded file and non-text content are removed or masked in messages.

methods.name: test_strip_base64_keeps_non_file_content()
methods.description: Verifies that non-file, plain text messages remain unchanged after stripping.

methods.name: test_strip_base64_handles_empty_or_missing_messages()
methods.description: Ensures function handles missing or empty message lists gracefully.

methods.name: test_strip_base64_mixed_nested_objects()
methods.description: Handles nested or complex message structures, ensuring non-text and non-file content is preserved or removed correctly.

methods.name: test_s3_verify_false_handling
methods.description: Regression test to confirm that s3_verify=False is not ignored and passed correctly to the HTTP client setup.

methods.name: test_s3_verify_none_handling
methods.description: Ensures that unspecified s3_verify defaults appropriately, and default SSL verification is used.

methods.name: test_s3_verify_false_creates_httpx_client_with_verify_false
methods.description: Checks that the httpx.AsyncClient is configured with verify=False when s3_verify=False.

methods.name: test_s3_verify_false_async_client
methods.description: Validates the asynchronous upload respects the verify=False configuration.

methods.name: test_strip_base64_recursive_redaction()
methods.description: Checks that deeply nested or multiple base64 content is fully redacted.

methods.name: patch_asyncio_create_task()
methods.description: Fixture that patches asyncio.create_task to prevent runtime errors during tests.

methods.name: test_s3_object_key_prefix_combinations( use_team_prefix, use_key_prefix, team_alias, key_alias, expected_prefix )
methods.description: Parametrized test to verify the correct formation of S3 object key prefixes based on team and key alias flags.

methods.name: test_prefix_priority_and_path_construction()
methods.description: Verifies prefix parts are combined correctly and no double slashes occur.

methods.name: test_prefix_absent_when_flags_disabled()
methods.description: Checks that no prefix is added when both prefix flags are false.

methods.name: test_combined_prefix_reflects_in_s3_object_key()
methods.description: Integration test ensuring the final S3 object key contains the expected combined prefixes.
